newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates end higher at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates end higher at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates rose slightly on Friday as the commercial banks began to fill up their reserves on the first day of the two-week reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight rates closed at 21 percent, compared with Friday's 20.75 percent closing.

"This is normal on the first day of the period," said Takarekbank's Istvan Zsoter, adding that Pentecost Monday would cut the number of working days in the reserve period, but the banks still have to meet central bank reserve requirements.
Dealers said the overnight rates were likely to remain close to 21 percent early next week, but would go down to levels between 20.5 to 20.75 percent later.
